mapper.insert: INSERT INTO oa_asset_depreciation_schedule (tenant_id, asset_id, period_no, period_date, depreciation_amount, accumulated_amount, net_value, status, version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) SELECT #{tenantId}, #{assetId}, period.period_no, period.period_date, period.depreciation_amount, period.accumulated_amount, period.net_value, 'PLANNED', 0, #{actor}, #{createdAt}, #{actor}, #{createdAt} FROM JSON_TABLE(#{periodsJson}, '$[*]' COLUMNS ( period_no INT PATH '$.periodNo' ERROR ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR, period_date DATE PATH '$.periodDate' ERROR ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR, depreciation_amount DECIMAL(10,2) PATH '$.depreciationAmount' ERROR ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR, accumulated_amount DECIMAL(10,2) PATH '$.accumulatedAmount' ERROR ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR, net_value DECIMAL(10,2) PATH '$.netValue' ERROR ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR )) AS period
mapper.update: UPDATE oa_asset_depreciation_schedule existing JOIN JSON_TABLE(#{periodsJson}, '$[*]' COLUMNS ( schedule_id BIGINT PATH '$.scheduleId' ERROR ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR, expected_version INT PATH '$.version' ERROR ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR, period_no INT PATH '$.periodNo' ERROR ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR, period_date DATE PATH '$.periodDate' ERROR ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR, depreciation_amount DECIMAL(10,2) PATH '$.depreciationAmount' ERROR ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR, accumulated_amount DECIMAL(10,2) PATH '$.accumulatedAmount' ERROR ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR, net_value DECIMAL(10,2) PATH '$.netValue' ERROR ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR, target_status VARCHAR(16) PATH '$.status' ERROR ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR )) AS period ON existing.schedule_id = period.schedule_id AND existing.version = period.expected_version SET existing.period_date = period.period_date, existing.depreciation_amount = period.depreciation_amount, existing.accumulated_amount = period.accumulated_amount, existing.net_value = period.net_value, existing.status = period.target_status, existing.version = existing.version + 1, existing.update_by = #{actor}, existing.update_time = #{updatedAt} WHERE existing.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND existing.asset_id = #{assetId} AND existing.period_no = period.period_no AND existing.status IN ('PLANNED', 'CANCELLED') AND period.target_status IN ('PLANNED', 'CANCELLED')
